description: Add a do-not-flag rule: behaviour the judge must stop reporting because the team decided it is correct. Give the rule in your own words, or a problem or a problem category to have it written from. It applies to conversations judged from now on. Add one only when the user says the behaviour is correct, never to make a run pass.

category.description: Or write it from this problem category (id or title).
category.title: Category

problem.description: Or write it from this problem, by its id.
problem.title: Problem

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

rule.description: The rule as one sentence naming the behaviour that is correct.
rule.title: Rule

name: add_never_flag_rule
